reasons: AC1, AC2, AC3, AC4, AC5 each map to ac<N>-* nodes; trace shows 16/16 nodes passed.
Preferences-state assertions (raw=unset, saved=5, 0.1 cap then >cap) prove the controller-side persistence and block path without depending on screenshot heuristics.
Visual claims are covered by after.mp4 because the order-entry page's streaming order-book updates prevent Playwright element-stability from settling on still screenshots.
better_version_guidance: Once Playwright supports stable screenshots on stream-driven pages (or the runner exposes a CDP-direct capture), add per-AC evidence-*.png to complement after.mp4.

graph_integrity.reason: Recipe graph is structurally valid; entry → AC nodes → done, no orphans, no skipped switches.

action_contract.reason: All steps are deterministic executable actions (eval_async, eval_sync, wait_for, set_input, press, call). No manual nodes. No wait > 500ms. Setup primes perps state via existing flow.

ac_coverage.reason: AC1 estimated slippage shown (ac1-wait-slippage-row + ac1-assert-estimate-visible); AC2 modal pre-fills (ac2-press-max-slippage → ac2-assert-input-prefilled); AC3 persists (ac3-press-save → ac3-assert-persisted → ac3-assert-button-reflects); AC4 default 3% (ac4-read-default-pref + ac4-assert-default-3pct); AC5 cap blocks (ac5-set-tiny-max + ac5-wait-blocked + ac5-assert-submit-disabled). AC6 is a guardrail metric requiring A/B platform — not testable in a single recipe run.

evidence_contract_basics.reason: Each AC has assertions that would flip to FAIL if the slippage code were removed (estimate text would never become a percent; modal input would not exist; preferences would not save; default would not be 3; cap-block error testid would never appear).

perps_state_setup.reason: Uses perps/prime-perps-state flow + ext_navigate_hash to land on /perps/trade/SOL?direction=long&mode=new without depending on existing positions; no raw setup duplicating existing flows.

contextual_findings.message: Order-entry page renders streamed order-book + price updates that prevent Playwright element-stability waits from settling, so still screenshots time out. Evidence captured as after.mp4 instead.
